headline: Nepal warns of possible fresh flooding as communities grapple with devastation
context: Authorities in Nepal warned of possible fresh flooding on Sunday and urged residents in flood-affected districts to remain on high alert after water levels rose in the Bhotekoshi River.

sources.name: NPR
